role: five transparent white-foliage surface tree samples, not backgrounds

assets.name: Moonblossom
assets.detail: An elegant old cherry tree with a slightly curved dark trunk and a broad asymmetrical umbrella canopy. Its left branch is shorter and lifted; the long right branch opens into multiple pearl-white blossom clusters separated by clear air. A few fine dark twigs are visible at canopy edges. A balanced premium hero tree, restful rather than busy.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium standalone tree prop sprite for an original atmospheric monochrome 2D side-scrolling game. Create ONE entire tree, from crown tips to grounded trunk base, isolated on a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND. The tree must have CHARCOAL-BLACK bark and branches with SOFT WHITE / PEARL-WHITE leaves and delicate white blossoms. The reference inspiration is the elegant branch shape and clustered flowering foliage of cherry/plum trees; convert all pink/red foliage to white. Refined hand-painted naturalism with a strong readable 2D silhouette, restrained painterly detail, soft organic edges and beautiful irregular negative spaces through canopy. Not a photoreal photograph, not vector clip art, not a cartoon. Medium foliage density, never a solid cotton blob or snow cap. Delicate individual leaf/petal shapes visible around the edges, interesting major branches visible between clusters. Ivory/silver/white and charcoal only: NO pink, red, blue, green or yellow. The black trunk must remain clearly readable. No artificial halo, neon glow or white outline. Fully visible tree, 5 percent transparent padding all around. Bottom of trunk terminates on ONE clean horizontal ground-contact baseline, with only subtle short buried-looking roots, no exposed spider roots or floating roots. There is NO ground strip beneath it. Only the TREE is opaque; all outside space and spaces between leaves and branches are true transparency. DO NOT draw detached falling petals: those will be separate animated game particles. NO background, sky, landscape, mountains, buildings, moon, sun, water, fog, smoke, floor plane, cast shadow, white backdrop, black backdrop, painted checkerboard, text, logo, people or creatures. This is a ground prop asset for the same playable surface as the hero, not a background painting.
Specific design: An elegant old cherry tree with a slightly curved dark trunk and a broad asymmetrical umbrella canopy. Its left branch is shorter and lifted; the long right branch opens into multiple pearl-white blossom clusters separated by clear air. A few fine dark twigs are visible at canopy edges. A balanced premium hero tree, restful rather than busy.

assets.name: Wind-swept Plum
assets.detail: A graceful windswept plum tree with a dark trunk leaning gently to the RIGHT and angular rising branches. The white blossom canopy stretches in the breeze like two layered broken ribbons, thin at the left and lush at the far right. Leave a generous open pocket beneath the long right bough. Restrained branch count, sparse low twigs.

assets.name: Weeping White
assets.detail: A refined weeping cherry tree with a slender dark forked trunk and a soft cascading canopy of white leaves and blossoms on long graceful down-curving outer branches. Several separated draping clusters frame open gaps, never a solid white curtain. Leaf tips end well above the ground and the black trunk remains visible. Quiet and poetic, not a willow forest.

assets.name: Silver Fan
assets.detail: A tall delicate white-leaved ornamental tree with two close dark upright leaders sharing a SINGLE grounded base. A narrower fan-shaped crown has five to seven airy little white foliage islands at different heights; thin organic dark branches show through the silver-white leaves. Elegant vertical rhythm and more negative space than the other samples, not a birch grove and not white bark.

assets.name: Ancient Blossom
assets.detail: An ancient sculptural flowering tree with a stout gnarled charcoal trunk bending in a subtle S, one low lateral branch to the LEFT and a wide flat sweeping upper branch to the RIGHT. Several small pearl-white blossom clusters sit like an irregular broken cloud along the branches. Beautiful spare ink-painting rhythm, not a bonsai pot; natural full-size tree with a simple grounded base and no giant exposed roots.
